newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian rebels free 10 convicts in van attack.
newsitem.headline: Colombian rebels free 10 convicts in van attack.

text.p: Leftist guerrillas ambushed a prison truck and freed 10 convicts in southern Colombia on Tuesday, authorities said.

The Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) were blamed for the attack on the road between Florencia in Caqueta province and Neiva in Huila province, in which six prison guards were stripped of their weapons but otherwise unharmed. The van was set on fire.
Two of the released prisoners had been charged with sedition and rebellion. Most of the others had been sentenced on murder charges.
FARC rebels raided two jails in central and southwest Colombia in mid-January, freeing 65 inmates.
